主要内容: On June 21, 2013, DISH Network Corporation decided to abandon its efforts to acquire Sprint Nextel Corporation. As a result, DISH DBS Corporation, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of DISH Network, gave notice to redeem all of its outstanding 5% Senior Notes due 2017 and all of its outstanding 6.25% Senior Notes due 2023 in a special mandatory redemption. The $1.25 billion aggregate principal amount of the 2017 Notes and the $1.35 billion aggregate principal amount of the 2023 Notes, issued on May 28, 2013, will be redeemed in full on June 24, 2013. The redemption price for the 2017 Notes will be 100% of the aggregate principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest from May 28, 2013 to June 24, 2013. The redemption price for the 2023 Notes will be 101% of the aggregate principal amount plus accrued and unpaid interest from May 28, 2013 to June 24, 2013.
